name: Lapáncsa (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and green at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Lapáncsa (a blue shield with a yellow star, a sun and a heart, with a white chevron) within a green wreath, above a yellow scroll inscribed LAPÁNCSA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lapáncsa arms with wreath and scroll
